title: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.37149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. translated_title: GCSR-OCC：面向开放词汇占据预测的几何校准与语义路由
translated_abstract: 开放词汇3D占据预测在统一的体素网格中表示场景几何与语义，能够识别超出预定义类别的对象。其中一种方法使用3D高斯重建场景并将其转换为体素占据。然而，高斯尺度膨胀和过度重叠会扭曲体素占据预测，而跨越多个类别的高斯内部以及3D-2D语义特征对齐过程中可能产生语义混合。我们提出GCSR-OCC，该方法结合几何校准与多模式查询条件语义路由，用于从单张RGB图像进行室内占据预测。证据保持的高斯到占据算子（EC-G2O）采用核质量归一化、p范数聚合和可学习增益，在校准占据响应的同时抑制尺度膨胀和过度的局部证据累积。多模式查询优先的高斯语义路由（MM-QGSR）通过匹…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GCSR-OCC框架，通过证据保持的高斯到占据算子抑制尺度膨胀与过度重叠，并结合多模式查询条件语义路由解决语义混合问题，实现从单张RGB图像的开放词汇室内3D占据预测。
